speeches.script: Pills? Transplants? Why does a hairline terrify you?
Five hundred years ago, women PAID to look bald up there.
Leonardo's ladies. Raphael's madonnas. All of them — sculpted foreheads, gone eyebrows.
Every morning: tweezers, wax, maybe even a razor. Beauty was pain — and they leaned in.
A high forehead meant you were educated, noble — too refined for manual labor. Intelligence made visible.
So next time you're worried about your hairline — congratulations. You have Renaissance taste.
